summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. furnished a Form 6-K containing an English translation of its September 17, 2026 letter to the Bolsa de Comercio de Buenos Aires and the CNV, calling a General Ordinary and Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting for October 22, 2026, virtually from Buenos Aires headquarters, first call 1:00 p.m. and second call 2:00 p.m. The agenda covers fiscal 2026 (ended June 30, 2026) financials, net income of ARS 244,516,111,286.75, and a cash and/or in-kind dividend distribution of up to ARS 116,000,000,000, plus board and supervisory committee elections, auditor appointments and related authorizations. Attendance notice deadline is October 16, 2026, 3:00 p.m. Routine AGM/EGM notice, not a special situation; the dividend vote is the only item with capital-return relevance and remains subject to shareholder approval.
